verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows developer building blocks: the Bot/REST API, Gateway WebSocket events, webhooks and slash commands, which a developer can use to write and host their own automated app. No evidence shows a first-party automation feature that a user can set up to run autonomously in the background, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
